about: SCION-24 parameter table. Ranges are the allowed ranges (source-sensitive limits); keyformed axes interpolate between true angle drawings.

params.what: body yaw: 0 = profile facing the door (screen left), 90 = toward the viewer, 180 = facing away from the door (screen right)
params.driven_by: acting sheet (motion.js A.bodyYaw): the refusal turn 3.47-3.93 s and the return 8.06-8.78 s, both through 90 (toward the viewer)

params.what: head yaw in the world, same convention; -45 = head turned into the depth of the room (back of the head to the viewer)
params.driven_by: acting sheet A.headYaw: leads the body by 2-3 frames; over the shoulder at 7.47-7.92 s; into the room 26.62-27.2 s
acting sheet A.headPitch, minus 6 deg per unit of score act.rest

params.what: head roll, a rotation deformer after the keyform blend
gaze along the eye (toward the muzzle +); separate from the head
params.driven_by: acting sheet A.eyeX: the eyes move first (whale eye at 3.46, 6.3, 7.5 s)
blinks (motion.js BLINKS), widening on the calls, heavier lids while refusing and when settled

params.what: brow pips raised and drawn in (worry)

params.driven_by: acting sheet A.mouth (relaxed open mouth lying, the exhale at 29.2 s)

params.what: 0 flat back, 1 pricked (score act.ear) + ear physics
params.driven_by: score act.ear + one-ear lags (earLag) + ear pendulum

params.what: 0 high, 0.5 hanging, 1.35 tucked (score act.tail) + tail physics
params.driven_by: score act.tail -> tail chain targets; tail pendulum

params.what: tail sweep amplitude (score act.wag), driven by the tail pendulum
params.driven_by: score act.wag -> tail chain lateral target

params.what: chin down onto the forepaws (score act.rest)
params.driven_by: score act.rest (held 25.9-26.42 s so the look-in starts from stillness)

params.what: neck raise: 0 head low, 1 head up (score act.head)
params.driven_by: score act.head through a piecewise map (head low on the approach)
breath oscillator, faster when afraid; the sigh at 29.15 s

inner_axes: ParamMouthOpen (jaw rotation about the hinge landmark)

deformer_hierarchy: root (score x, torso middle) -> ParamBodyAngleX yaw
-> torso art meshes (chest, waist, rump volumes; saddle, blaze, belly markings clipped to the torso)
-> neck (ParamNeck, 0.55 of the head-body yaw difference) -> head keyform blend -> roll (ParamAngleZ) -> eyes, brows, ears, nose, mouth
-> 4 legs: shoulder/hip -> elbow/knee -> wrist/hock -> paw, two-bone solve to the planted foot
-> tail: 7 rotation segments from the tail pendulum
